comment.text: Label of the small button in the header of a private room, next to the room menu, showing that the user's encryption key is unlocked on this device; pressing it opens the key actions. A short state label (adjective or participle), not a command.

usage.context:
<span data-testid="key_lock_state">
 <Badge
 label={
 keyState === "locked"
 ? t("Common:KeyLocked")
 : t("Common:KeyUnlocked")
 }
 backgroundColor={KEY_STATUS_BADGE_COLORS[keyState].background}
 color={KEY_STATUS_BADGE_COLORS[keyState].text}
 maxWidth="none"
 />
